interpreted_intent: Independently design and render a complex randomized photographic test scene using the attached person as appearance reference, then test visual realization. The hillside transit location and infrastructure staging are agent-authored choices, with coordinator-owned outdoor family guidance.
subject: One adult woman whose facial appearance and hair follow the attached portrait
setting: Terraced hillside bus interchange after rain on an overcast morning
event: Woman pauses with her left hand on a handrail and both feet supported on a stair landing
visual_priorities: Natural background material fidelity and continuous transit infrastructure geometry
Plausible visible handrail contact and body support
baseline_prompt_en: Create a natural editorial photograph of one adult woman at a terraced hillside bus interchange on an overcast morning after rain. Use the attached portrait as her facial appearance and hair reference: retain the softly oval face, dark brown eyes, full natural lips, and long loose dark wavy hair. She wears a charcoal weatherproof coat over a cream knit top, straight dark trousers and practical ankle boots. She pauses on a broad concrete stair landing, both boot soles resting flat on the same level surface, her left hand lightly wrapped around the waist-high metal handrail beside her left hip while her right hand holds a small canvas tote beside her right thigh. Her torso turns a little toward the camera, with a quiet attentive expression. Both forearms and the hand-to-rail contact remain visible. The rail continues down the adjacent stairs, leaving clear standing space around her feet. Show her full figure within a spacious architectural view. A foreground drainage grate meets the landing edge; the stairs rise behind her to a steel and glass bus shelter; a retaining wall and hillside apartment facades occupy successively deeper planes. Concrete stair joints, tile paving seams and shelter posts retain consistent perspective and human scale. Rain darkens sheltered concrete unevenly, with a shallow puddle beside the drain and small scuffs along the handrail. Glass panels transmit the structures behind them and catch the pale sky. Soft overhead daylight reaches her face and the surrounding construction with matching direction and restrained contrast. Keep the ordinary infrastructure legible across the image, with believable material surfaces and continuous geometry. The result should feel like a candid photograph made at an actual working transit stop.
